text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday.
While walking through the city...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! What kind of game is this—?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief.
What happened to all that confidence from earlier?
choice_data_list: In the middle of a versus match? Looks like fun.
In the middle of a versus match? Looks like fun, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, it's you.
I'm just being dragged along."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
The car racing game here is super popular at the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
See, this guy loves dead-heat battles like this, right?
That's why I brought him along.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Care to try your hand at it too?
Brian's actually pretty skilled, you know.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give it a try...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I'll humor you.
Just make sure you show me some real backbone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we ended up playing a racing game—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let you pass...! I'm gonna leave you in the dust all the way to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! You're slowing down!
Did you lose your focus already!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Startled by Narita Brian's speed, they momentarily hesitate to overtake. ...And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
!? With a feint...
I got passed...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, what kind of technique was that just now?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Guess you haven't been a Trainer just for show, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Assessing your own capabilities and structuring how you run around them...
...I'll admit you've got some know-how."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well isn't that amazing, you!
What on earth did you do!?
choice_data_list: I just made the most of my explosive power.
I'm just taking a short breather, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh.
You bet on a single moment of explosive power, did you?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Well, that was way more fun than I expected.
choice_data_list: I had a great time too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Wait.
Who said this was over?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? You still wanna keep going?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just when things are getting fun.
Next time, I'll blow past you with overwhelming speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Narita Brian focusing on a speed-oriented running style, she achieved a crushing victory.
It seemed to serve as a nice change of pace for her too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Catching prey off guard while conserving stamina... simultaneously...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, so even games have things
in common with actual races, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Looks like we're in for a thrilling dead heat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ama-san, let's head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What is it, got so heated up that a game couldn't settle it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Challenge accepted!
Next time, it won't be as easy as a game.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
Otherwise, overtaking you wouldn't be worth the effort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian seemed to have immediately put what she realized into practice
during the subsequent joint training session.
